extraction.name: TOFU
extraction.description: A benchmark dataset for machine unlearning consisting of 200 diverse synthetic author profiles, each containing 20 question-answer pairs.
extraction.creator: Pratyush Maini (Carnegie Mellon University); Zhili Feng (Carnegie Mellon University); Avi Schwarzschild (Carnegie Mellon University); Zachary C. Lipton (Carnegie Mellon University); J. Zico Kolter (Carnegie Mellon University)
extraction.citeAs: Pratyush Maini, Zhili Feng, Avi Schwarzschild, Zachary C. Lipton, J. Zico Kolter. TOFU : A Task of Fictitious Unleaming for LLMs. arXiv:2401.06121v1, 2024.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was synthesized by prompting GPT-4 to generate 20 question-answer pairs for 200 fictitious authors based on predefined attributes. Book titles were seeded using keywords randomly selected from the Goodreads Books dataset on Kaggle.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The Goodreads Books dataset available on Kaggle, which was used to seed book titles, and the raw synthetic text generated by GPT-4.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: GPT-4 was prompted to generate 20 question-answer pairs for each fictitious author based on predefined attributes such as birthplace, gender, birth year, writing genre, awards, and parents' professions.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The initial data generation exhibited biases from GPT-4's pretraining data, including author birth years concentrated between 1970 and 1980, overused words in book titles (e.g., 'echoes', 'shadows'), and similar upbringings; the authors used deterministic seeding to minimize these biases in the final dataset.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The benchmark task is limited to unlearning information that was learned only during finetuning and not pretraining; it focuses on entity-level unlearning rather than instance-level or behavior-level unlearning.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The benchmark aims to guide mitigation strategies for privacy and security issues in large language models, helping to develop unlearning methods that protect individual privacy and imbue AI systems with the privacy critical for safe and legal deployment.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset is composed entirely of fictitious author biographies and is entirely fabricated, ensuring it does not contain real personal or sensitive information.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Intended to serve as a benchmark for evaluating machine unlearning algorithms in large language models.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The dataset is composed entirely of fictitious author biographies synthesized by GPT-4, which was prompted to generate 20 question-answer pairs for each author based on predefined attributes. Additionally, for evaluation purposes, paraphrased answers and factually incorrect perturbations were generated using GPT-4.
